value.syntax: # [doc = " Where a token or a syntax tree node sits in the source."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " Byte offsets slice the source; the line and column locate the *start*"] # [doc = " for a human, both 1-based, the column counted in characters rather than"] # [doc = " bytes so that a multi-byte name does not push the reported column past"] # [doc = " what the reader sees."] # [derive (Copy , Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq)] pub (crate) struct Span { # [doc = " Byte offset of the first byte."] pub (crate) start : usize , # [doc = " Byte offset one past the last byte."] pub (crate) end : usize , # [doc = " 1-based line of [`Span::start`]."] pub (crate) line : u32 , # [doc = " 1-based character column of [`Span::start`]."] pub (crate) column : u32 , }
